kashika: भविष्यतीत्येव। शेषः क्रियार्थोपपदादन्यः। शेषे शुद्धे भविष्यति काले, चकारात् क्रियायां चोपपदे क्रियार्थायां धातोर्लृट प्रत्ययो भवति। करिष्यामीति व्रजति। हरिष्यामीति व्रजति। शेषे खल्वपि — करिष्यति। हरिष्यति॥
kashikaEnglish: लृट् (second future) elsewhere for simple futurity or gerundial: करिष्यामि इति व्रजति 'he goes (saying) I will do', करिष्यति 'he will do'.
englishShort: When a helper action is done for doing a main action in future (For example, 'going to school  for studying'), the लृट्लकार can be used to denote the main action ('studying' in this example). In addition, the लृट्लकार can also be used to indicate a general action to be done in future, even when no helper action is indicated.
englishFull:
लृट् शेषे च — The Second Future (लृट्) applies:
1. In remaining cases of simple futurity
2. When in construction with a verb denoting action performed for the future action's sake

| Example | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| करिष्यामि इति व्रजति | "He goes [thinking] 'I will do'" |
| करिष्यति | "He will do" (simple future) |
| हरिष्यति | "He will take" |

The Second Future serves both dependent clauses and independent simple-future expressions.
